title.zh: 以太坊研究草案拟将交易最终性缩短至约4分钟，以降低跨链转账成本
title.en: 以太坊研究草案拟将交易最终性缩短至约4分钟，以降低跨链转账成本

current_state.zh: Ethereum researchers submitted a draft proposal to shorten transaction finality from roughly 16 minutes to about 4 minutes by separating block selection from finalization, which could reduce cross-chain transfer capital costs and ease future quantum-resistant signature adoption.
current_state.en: Ethereum researchers submitted a draft proposal to shorten transaction finality from roughly 16 minutes to about 4 minutes by separating block selection from finalization, which could reduce cross-chain transfer capital costs and ease future quantum-resistant signature adoption.
